decisions.reason: The thermoforming unit is close to the core dental equipment offer, has been shown on its own page for two years, and is part of the integrated workflow the firm has publicly committed to, so management will persist with it.

Although the orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core business, it was only launched in 2024 with a dedicated web page and fits the announced push into digital custom manufacturing, so weak early results can still be blamed on ramp-up and management will stand by its decision.

The post-curing unit complements the firm's digital and 3D printing workflow and its certified equipment line, so the investment and its strategic fit argue for keeping it despite its modest web presence.
